name: Hiller Bros., Inc. and East Over Farm
tagline: Hiller Bros., Inc. & East Over Farm
description: In Rochester, MA, Hiller Bros., Inc. and East Over Farm raises Blueberries and Pumpkins on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
